question: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) is located in which of the following industrial regions of India?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) is located in Bangalore-Chennai industrial regions of India

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is an Indian state-owned aerospace and Defence company based in Bangalore, Karnataka.
 
• It is governed under the management of the Indian Ministry of Defence.
 
• HAL was established as Hindustan Aircraft in Bangalore on 23 Dec 1940 and later renamed in 1964.
 
• HAL built the first military aircraft in South Asia.
 
• It is currently involved in the design, fabrication and assembly of aircraft, jet engines, helicopters and their spare parts.
 
• It has several facilities spread across India.
